A newly created Fighter starts with: **Longsword, Shield, Potion of Healing, and Torches** (item IDs 2, 15, 17, 23).

Defined in `CLASS_STARTING_ITEMS` in `worker/src/services/character.ts` (referenced via `createCharacter`, lines ~59/65), with item names/IDs seeded in `worker/src/db/seed.sql` (items 1–28 reference table). Note: ID 23 is actually "Torches" despite code comments calling it "Rations" (documented bug B-09).
